1 ضَعَّ , (S, O, K,) an inf. n. of which the verb is ضَعَّ, aor.
ضََُعَ , (TK,) The breaking, or training, (S,) or training well, (IAar, O, K,) a he-camel, (IAar, S, O, K,) and a she-camel, not previously trained: (IAar, O, K:) or the saying to a camel ↓ ضَعْ in order that he may become well trained. (Th, S, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
